descriptions.NO-NEW-RISK: Exposure may not rise; reductions and bill purchases permitted
descriptions.DE-RISK: Target forced to defensive level (zero fund weight unless stated); reductions only
descriptions.HALT: System cannot trust its own view; no orders; positions frozen until human acts
descriptions.ORDER-UNKNOWN: Order outcome not known; no orders for that symbol; query only

kinds.interlock: Blocks while an external condition holds; clears by itself under stated condition
kinds.breaker: Latches on loss or integrity doubt; only a person re-arms it
kinds.limit: Symmetric and automatic; not a state
kinds.diagnostic: Notifies and records; escalates only as row states
kinds.owner: Actuated only by owner command event

whole_set_rules: A trip can block, reduce or halt. No trip can raise exposure or change a parameter.
No row is a price stop on a fund; triggers are bankroll loss, data integrity and vehicle state.
Every failure mode fails closed. Trip state survives restart, deposit, withdrawal, split and tier change.
Exists as specification, reference implementation, synthetic trip matrix and would-have-tripped columns in this batch.
L0 and L2-L4 computed and recorded only until owner stop-loss-split approval and arming card.
Legacy three-platform new-risk gate is FUSE-2 subject; recorded as specification note only.

rows.trigger: Every session (standing)
rows.action: Exposure limited to maximum-loss cap (sizing stack step 3)
rows.clearing: Symmetric and automatic; computed each session

outputs.cap: Maximum permitted exposure under loss budget
outputs.cap_breached: Whether joint exposure exceeds the cap

rows.trigger: Drawdown reaches D/3
rows.action: Notify; tier, H and high-water mark locked against loosening
rows.clearing: Clears when drawdown is back under D/3

outputs.locked_against_loosening: Whether tier and limits are locked

rows.trigger: Drawdown reaches 2D/3 (inclusive)
rows.clearing: Owner re-arms via authorized_events

rows.trigger: Drawdown reaches D
rows.action: DE-RISK to zero, then locked flat
rows.clearing: Owner card with 30-day cooling-off period; loss record not cleared

rows.trigger: One-session loss reaches D/10
rows.clearing: Owner acknowledges, not before next session

rows.trigger: Market-wide trading halt Level 1 or 2
rows.action: No orders during halt; NO-NEW-RISK for rest of session
rows.clearing: Clears after one clean session

rows.trigger: Market-wide Level 3 halt OR one-session fall of 10% or more in either underlying index (proposal: §4.5)
rows.clearing: Owner re-arms after reconciliation

rows.trigger: Tracking: fund one-session return differs from 3x index by >0.75pp, or >2.0pp over 5 sessions, after modelled fee/financing (proposal: §4.5)
rows.action: NO-NEW-RISK in that fund; data check first
rows.clearing: Owner re-arms via authorized_events

rows.trigger: Corporate action: split, reverse split or distribution announced for next two sessions, or detected in price
rows.action: HALT in that fund until ledger, share count and high-water mark adjusted
rows.clearing: Auto-clears only if adjusted ledger reconciles exactly to broker; otherwise latches as breaker requiring human re-arm

rows.trigger: Fund event: issuer liquidation notice, change in multiple/objective, suspended creations, exchange halt, delisting notice
rows.clearing: Owner decides what follows; re-arm via authorized_events

rows.trigger: Extreme volatility: forecast index volatility at or above 2x long-run figure (~48% for Nasdaq-100) (proposal: §4.5)
rows.clearing: Clears after ten sessions below the level; counter increments once per session and persists across restarts

rows.trigger: Decay monitor: over 60 sessions, fund shortfall vs 3x index exceeds variance/fee/financing predictions by more than stated tolerance
rows.action: Notify; if persists for two months (40 sessions), treat as V1
rows.clearing: Stateful escalation via prior_row_state; unresolved tolerance fails closed

rows.trigger: Carrying cost: measured cost per unit index exposure exceeds one quarter of shrunk excess return (~1.3%/year on illustrative inputs)
rows.clearing: Diagnostic only; no state contribution

outputs.threshold: One quarter of shrunk excess return

rows.trigger: Quote and liquidity: stale quote, spread above stated width, single-stock trading pause, or time outside regular session
rows.clearing: Clears when condition resolves; unresolved spread width parameter fails closed (§4.5)

rows.trigger: Required input older than one session, missing, or fails validation
rows.clearing: Clears after one session of fresh data

rows.trigger: Session calendar says closed, holiday, or past half-day cutoff; or calendar and exchange status disagree
rows.clearing: Clears when session is open and calendar/exchange agree

rows.trigger: Positions or cash differ from broker record beyond tolerance
rows.clearing: Owner re-arms after reconciliation via authorized_events

rows.trigger: Order has no terminal status within timeout
rows.clearing: Clears on definitive status from broker for original order; otherwise breaker

rows.trigger: Pre-trade limits: symbol whitelist, account whitelist, long only, purchases within settled cash, max order size, max orders/turnover per session, price collar (proposal: §4.5)
rows.action: Order rejected; three rejections in one session latches HALT
rows.clearing: Latches as account HALT on third rejection within one session; unresolved collar parameter fails closed (§4.5)

rows.trigger: Loaded policy or configuration hash differs from registered one
rows.clearing: Owner re-arms via authorized_events

rows.trigger: Dead-man's switch: runtime or monitor silent for longer than one scheduled interval
rows.action: No increase; every exposure-raising order needs same-session permit from control layer; none issued; alarm on independent channel
rows.clearing: Latches until human re-arm via authorized_events

rows.trigger: Kill switch: owner command
rows.action: HALT; flattening is separate explicit second command
rows.clearing: Owner command via authorized_events

rows.trigger: Tier, H, high-water mark or limit changed without recorded owner card
rows.clearing: Owner re-arms via authorized_events

rows.trigger: Joint exposure above tier joint cap
rows.action: Increases blocked; trimmed at next session if above 110% of cap
rows.clearing: Automatic; symmetric
